items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995
items.q: Mr. Bob Weinstock... has graciously come out of semi-retirement... to produce some records for Milestone now, and I’m very, very honored and thrilled that I could be part of his... return into the industry.

ctx.x: Yeah. They won’t forget about it.
The most important thing is they gave me an opportunity to musically expose them to the world, you know. Because Milestone Fantasy has been very kind to help promote my © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

career at the moment, and Mr. Bob Weinstock, who used to, who started Prestige Records, he’s graciously come out of semi-retirement down in Florida to produce some records for Milestone now, and I’m very, very honored and thrilled that I could be part of his, you know, return into the industry.
